schema: Count matrix 94,528 guide rows x 122 columns (7 identifiers/coordinates/gene/sequence fields + 115 MUS raw-count columns); library table 94,528 rows x 5 fields (SEQUENCE, GUIDE_ID, GENE, EXON, SeqScore); SOFT 175 GEO samples; derived mapping 97 MUS columns joined to GSM/title/characteristics
conditions: Six mouse tumor lines with paired CTL and matched control columns among mapped data; three culture replicates per arm; untreated controls except B16-Ova and MC38-Ova use WT-CD8 controls; Renca-HA T-cell arm is separate from antigen-free Renca IFN-gamma/TNF-alpha arms; endpoints span study-defined screen rounds/timepoints
units: Raw reads per guide/sample. Inference unit for cross-line reproducibility is the cell line/model (six); cultures are replicate measurements, guides are nested perturbations.
measured_vs_derived: Measured raw guide counts and gene-level MAGeCK LFC/FDR are provided by sources. Pilot derived exploratory whole-library log-frequency contrasts from guide counts using the frozen formula/filter; not direct lysis, published drugZ, or MAGeCK reproduction.
access_and_limits: Official public GEO files, all within per-file/aggregate byte limits. 97/115 count columns map; the 18 unmatched are MUS_22-24, MUS_31-33, MUS_77-79, MUS_106-108, MUS_115-120. Their absence does not remove the six mapped CTL/control line contrasts; do not pool Renca-HA and Renca cytokine experiments.

schema: One sheet, 1,022 x 11 including header: Gene plus five MAGeCK LFC/FDR contrast pairs: SP_cd19.10m_v_egfr.15m; BM_cd19.10m_v_egfr.15m; BM_cd19.15m_v_egfr.15m; cd19_1to2_v_egfr_1to2; cd19_1to10_v_egfr_1to10
conditions: Anti-CD19 versus control anti-hEGFRvIII CAR-T. In vitro E:T 1:2 and 1:10 (CAR-T added day 9, cells harvested day 14). In vivo SP=spleen and BM=bone marrow; 10m/15m are 1x10^7/1.5x10^7 CAR-T cells per mouse; peak suppression harvest on/before day 3. Some workbook headers encode an apparent 10m-vs-15m dose mismatch; do not treat those as dose-matched.
units: One syngeneic murine B-ALL model; genes in the selected validation panel are not independent experimental units.
measured_vs_derived: Derived gene-level MAGeCK LFC and FDR from guide-selection measurements; not direct percent killing.
access_and_limits: Official publisher supplement downloaded and opened. This is a selected 1,021-gene validation panel, not the full genome-wide primary screen; the dose-mismatched in-vivo comparison and single leukemia model limit cross-setting attribution/generalization.
